@Bettina Kroll, the dates in the brain don't settle this cleanly, so I'd check before the tracker goes out.

- **Nov 3, 2025:** Moss's 2 Nov Coastal digest says ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03." That is the official handoff date.
- **Nov 22, 2025:** Your own 8 Dec recap in the wiki says the official handoff was Nov 3, that you kept running PHL day to day until Nov 21 for the terminal cutover, and that Kwame "fully took over on November 22."

If the tracker wants the date Kwame took over fully, use Nov 22. If it wants the official handoff, use Nov 3. The digest excerpt I can see doesn't name the recipient, so I can't confirm from it that the Nov 3 handoff was to Kwame. The Nov 22 date comes only from your recap.
